message.content:
Painting the entire Eiffel Tower would be a massive undertaking. Roughly speaking, you’d need:

| Task | Estimated Time |
|------|----------------|
| **Surface prep (cleaning, priming)** | 2–3 weeks (for a full crew working on all three levels) |
| **Actual painting** | 4–6 weeks (again, assuming a large crew and continuous work) |
| **Dry‑time & finishing touches** | 1–2 weeks |

So, from start to finish, you’re looking at **about 7–11 weeks** (roughly 2–3 months) if you have a dedicated crew and the weather cooperates. If you’re doing it part‑time or with a smaller crew, it could stretch out to several months longer.
